note: Frozen design parameters chosen before any evaluation result exists. Never change these to make a candidate pass; criteria_sha256 of this file is recorded in evaluation.json.

criteria.description: Median weekly energy error <= 30 % and worst week <= 50 %
Model MAE <= 0.9 x naive MAE (at least 10 % better)
Model median weekly energy error <= naive median weekly energy error
If driver_analysis is true: model ON/OFF F1 > naive ON/OFF F1
Median actual weekly energy in the evaluation weeks >= MIN_BASELINE_KWH_WEEK
Every evaluation week has >= 80 % coverage; at least 3 weeks (test) or 2 weeks (development_only)

undefined_metric_rule: A required metric that cannot be computed or is not finite is stored as null, its criterion fails with reason metric_undefined:<metric>, and the appliance is no_go.
